data.text:
Premnath Tukaram More vs The Superintendent Of Police And ... 
on 21 August, 2024 
Author: Shivkumar Dige
Bench: Shivkumar Dige
 1 925 aba.1413.2
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay,
 Bench At Aurangabad.
 925 Anticipatory Bail Application No. 1413 Of 2024 
 Premnath Tukaram More
 Versus
 The Superintendent Of Police And Another
 ... 
 Advocate for Applicant : Mr. P. P. More. 
 App for Respondent/State : Mr. P. P. Dawalkar. 
 ... 
 Coram : Shivkumar Dige, J.
 Date : 21st August, 2024. 
 P.C.: 
 . Heard. 
 2 Issue notice to the respondents, returnable on 29th August, 2024. 
The learned APP waives notice on behalf of both the respondents. 
3 In the event of arrest of applicant in connection with Crime No.418 of 2024, registered at Gandhi Chowk Police Station, District Latur, for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273 and 328 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, he be released on executing personal bond of Rs.20,000/- with one surety in the like amount. The applicant shall attend the concerned police station as and when required and shall co-operate in the investigation.
